Rules run by themselves, also after the phone restarts, as long as Termant is not force-stopped. Create one by asking in the chat, for example: \"roz raat 11 baje WiFi band karo\" or \"jab charging lage toh backup chalao\".
Needed only for rules or requests that send a text message.

The model\'s provider refused the request. With an OpenRouter key this usually means: the model is not free and the account has no credit, the free daily limit is used up, or free models are blocked in OpenRouter\'s privacy settings. Pick a model whose name ends in :free, or another provider.
Switched to %1$s: %2$s did not answer (limit reached or not available).
Other models were tried too; none answered.
Switched to %1$s in the middle of the work: %2$s reached its limit. The work carried on from where it was.

OpenCode\'s free limit is used up until about %1$s. It counts for all of OpenCode\'s free models together, and no model of another service is set up to take over. To keep working without this stop: Settings → add a key of another service (OpenRouter has free models, their names end in :free). The app then moves to it by itself, also in the middle of a task.

When a model stops answering, usually because its free limit is used up, try the next backup model by itself. In the middle of a task the next model carries on from where the work stopped. It stays on the model that worked for 3 hours. OpenCode\'s free models share one limit: add a key of another service below to have somewhere to switch to.
Models to switch to, tried from the top of the list. Tick none to use all free models. Models from a provider with your key may cost money unless that key is on a free plan.

resources.string: What the agent may use besides Ubuntu and the phone controls.
With a token the agent can clone your private repos, commit, push, and open issues and pull requests.
Make a token on GitHub (tick repo), copy it and paste it here. It stays on this phone, inside Ubuntu.
GitHub did not accept this token. Copy it again, or make a new one.
Token saved. GitHub could not be reached to check it.
The agent looks things up on the internet when it needs fresh facts. Free, no key needed.
Lets the agent read the screen and tap, type and swipe in other apps, like a person would.

With this on, the agent can open any app, read what it shows and tap, type and swipe for you.

• It acts only when you ask in the chat.
• It never types into password boxes.
• Turn it off here whenever you like.

On the next screen choose “Termant screen control” (under Installed or Downloaded apps) and switch it on.

If Android says “Restricted setting”: open App info for Termant, tap ⋮ at the top right, choose “Allow restricted settings”, then come back here.
Screen control is on. The agent can read the screen and tap, type and swipe in other apps when you ask it to.

Lets Termant’s AI agent read what is on the screen and tap, type and swipe in other apps when you ask it to in the chat. Where an app does not say what it shows, Termant takes a picture of the screen and reads the writing in it on the phone itself; the picture is not kept or sent anywhere. It does nothing on its own, records nothing, and never types into password boxes.
The agent has a question for you

While the agent works and you are in another app, a small card at the top says what it is doing, lets you stop it, shows its questions with buttons to choose or a box to type in, and keeps the answer up for 10 seconds with a box for your next message. Swipe the card up to send it away. Screen control brings this along; without it, allow it here.
Open Android Settings → Apps → Termant → Display over other apps yourself.

The agent keeps short notes about you and about what works on this phone, and makes small tools for jobs that come up again. It has both in every new chat. Say \"yaad rakho …\" or \"iska tool bana lo\" to teach it. Everything stays on this phone, but the notes are sent to the model\'s service with each message, like the message itself. ✕ removes one.
The agent writes to you first, like a friend who asks how you are. It uses what it has learned about you, and comes back to things you told it about.
Besides these, the agent picks its own moments to come back to something. Never more than 6 times a day, and not at night.
Up to 4 times of day, such as 09:00, 21:00. Leave it empty for no fixed times.
That is not a time of day. Write it like 09:00, 21:00.
To see what it is like.
